purpose: A single bar that shows parts of one whole, up to eight, with a legend that turns each series on and off. Use it for traffic by source, spend by team or storage by type.

notFor.case: A single share that is not part of a whole, such as progress.
Shares that mean good or bad.
More than eight parts, or values that must be read exactly.

Default.visual: Segments on Chart/series-n roles clipped to one bar; leader labels in Content/secondary and values in Content/primary, leader lines in Chart/series-n/solid.

a11y.keyboard: Tab visits the segments, then the legend items; Enter or Space presses (a segment calls onSegmentClick, a legend item turns its series on or off). No arrow keys.
a11y.reducedMotion: Decided by the motion foundation: the motion roles fall back to the system fade with no travel (design-plans/splitbar-contract.md).
notes: Named by aria-label or aria-labelledby (one is required).
Colour is never the only divider: every segment has a Chart/series-n/solid edge and the legend repeats label and value in text.
The last visible series cannot be turned off; a turned-off segment is aria-hidden and leaves the Tab order.

openQuestions: Contrast: Chart/series-n/content on its soft fill is under 4.5:1 in Light for series 2, 3, 4 and 6 (COL-CHART-01), and the off legend text is 3.58:1 (COL-CHART-02). Fix the roles or accept?
What should happen with more than eight segments: an error, an Other share, or nothing?
When a share means good or bad the usage says to use Status roles instead, but no Escala component does that. Is one needed?
The contract has no Figma set linked (finding DOC-001, codeOnly). Should it be added?
